data.long_meaning: Bamdad is derived from the Arabic root 'B-M-D' which means 'to extol, to glorify, to magnify, to praise'. This name is filled with honor, pride, and esteem. It represents the idea of being highly regarded and respected by others. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is a perfect example of this virtue. The name Bamdad carries the meaning “Glory, Honor, Pride” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bamdad usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, honor, pride and live with faith, good character and purpose.
